title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
On 1 October 2024 in Zurich Oerlikon, a 23 year old Chinese university student attacked three five year old boys with a knife, seriously injuring them. The blade was about 8.5 centimetres long. One boy's jugular vein was cut and needed emergency surgery, another was stabbed twice in the chest and nearly died from heart and blood vessel injuries, and the third suffered wounds to his ear and lung. A childcare worker grabbed the attacker's arms and stopped him, then passersby held him until police arrived.

Prosecutors say the man planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to research legal consequences and choosing children as targets. He bought clothes, a set of kitchen knives, studied anatomy, and purchased raw beef to practise stabbing. He acted on China's national day after posting patriotic messages. The prosecution has charged him with attempted murder and is asking for a 15 year prison sentence and a 15 year expulsion from Switzerland. He is due in court on Thursday.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
